evidence: The precursors were TiCl4 and Al(CH3)3 (TMA) (Aldrich). The deposition temperatures were typically in the range 200–350◦C, at a reactor pressure of about 10 mbar. The processing cycle consisted of: a 0.3 s pulse of TiCl4 for TiO2 deposition (a 0.4 s pulse of TMA for Al2O3 deposition); a 0.5 s purge pulse of N2; a 0.4 s pulse of water vapour as the nucleophilic source of oxygen; a 0.5 s purge pulse of N2.
